previous_findings.detail: Default script dialogs are disabled before first navigation. ScriptDialogOpening declines hidden/inactive hosts, retains event args and deferral only for visible foreground hosts, and posts presentation to a dedicated host HWND. Native modal processing holds shared state; nested presentation is guarded; hiding/closing ends the active dialog and drains queued deferrals. The active popped deferral completes after the modal loop returns. Dialog context remains on the live stack. Zero-filled template storage contains the standard header and three WORD-terminated variable arrays without intervening struct padding. Hidden alert/confirm/prompt outcomes are now asserted in the Windows harness.

The x64 installation staging entrypoint now verifies the loader and both notice sidecars against the clean current-main manifest before copying in both local and Actions paths. New tests exercise both paths, tampered bytes for each of three members, and missing loader. Builds predating the manifest retain prior staging behavior. SCons maps supported architectures to the corresponding pinned loader.

Native cache output inventory includes both generated notice files alongside DLLs, and the output list participates in cache identity. A new test removes all bin files, restores a cache hit without rebuilding, and checks loader plus both notices.

limits: Reviewer host is macOS. No Windows MSVC/clang-cl build or WebView2 runtime execution was performed by this reviewer; remote exact-candidate CI remains required and owned by root.

The hidden-HWND harness tests cancellation while the native parent is never shown. It does not execute the visible native dialog creation/accept/prompt-input branch, visible-to-hidden active-dialog cancellation, beforeunload interaction, or real native modal reentrancy. Those remain runtime/manual acceptance gaps; source review is not a runtime pass.
The harness uses /EHsc while production builds disable exceptions. Full production Windows compilation remains necessary.
Real editor input, IME, focus/DPI/visual layout, upload/download system panels, and production HTTPS/authentication have not been accepted here.
Only x64 Windows hidden runtime is wired in CI; source architecture mapping for x86/arm64 is not runtime validation of those architectures.
No desktop action, installation, source edit, commit or push was performed. Review validity is limited to the recorded bytes; implementation changes require re-review.

retained: This independent review receipt is necessary evidence.
